publisher: Pew Internet & American Life Project and Elon University
report: The Future of the Internet III

entries.label: The mobile phone is the primary connection tool for most people in the world
entries.quote: In 2020, while "one laptop per child" and other initiatives [...] are successful on many levels, the mobile phone - now with significant computing power - is the primary Internet connection and the only one for a majority of the people across the world, providing information in a portable, well-connected form at a relatively low price.
entries.subject: mobile phone as primary internet connection
entries.note: Answer options were 'mostly agree' and 'mostly disagree'. The scenario continues: universal telephony standards, and the 'bottom' three-quarters of the world's population account for at least 50% of people with internet access (up from 30% in 2005).

entries.label: Social tolerance has advanced significantly due in great part to the Internet
entries.quote: In 2020, people are more tolerant than they are today, thanks to wider exposure to others and their views that has been brought about by the Internet and other information and communication technologies. The greater tolerance shows up in several metrics, including declining levels of violence, lower levels of sectarian strife, and reduced incidence of overt acts of bigotry and hate crimes.
entries.subject: internet and social tolerance
entries.note: Answer options were 'mostly agree' and 'mostly disagree'.

entries.label: Content control through copyright-protection technology dominates
entries.quote: In 2020, strict content controls are in place thanks to the efforts of legislatures, courts, the technology industry, and media companies. Those who use copyrighted materials are automatically billed by content owners, and Internet service providers automatically notify authorities when they identify clients who try to subvert this system.
entries.subject: copyright-protection technology
entries.note: Answer options were 'mostly agree' and 'mostly disagree'. The scenario ends: protestors rarely prevail with free-speech and innovation claims.

entries.label: Transparency heightens individual integrity and forgiveness
entries.quote: In 2020, people are even more open to sharing personal information, opinions, and emotions than they are now. The public's notion of privacy has changed. [...] As people's lives have become more transparent, they have become more responsible for their own actions and more forgiving of the sometimes-unethical pasts of others.
entries.subject: transparency versus privacy
entries.note: Answer options were 'mostly agree' and 'mostly disagree'. Experts and all respondents split in opposite directions by one point.

entries.label: Many lives are touched by the use of augmented reality or spent interacting in artificial spaces
entries.quote: In 2020, virtual worlds, mirror worlds, and augmented reality are popular network formats. To be fully connected, advanced organizations and individuals must have a presence in the "metaverse" and/or the "geoWeb." Most well-equipped Internet users will spend some part of their waking hours [...] at least partially linked to augmentations of the real world or alternate worlds.
entries.subject: augmented reality and virtual worlds
entries.note: Answer options were 'mostly agree' and 'mostly disagree'.

entries.label: Talk and touch are common technology interfaces
entries.quote: People have adjusted to hearing individuals dictating information in public to their computing devices. In addition "haptic" technologies based on touch feedback have been fully developed, so, for instance, a small handheld Internet appliance allows you to display and use a full-size virtual keyboard on any flat surface [...]. It is common to see people "air-typing".
entries.subject: voice and touch interfaces
entries.note: Answer options were 'mostly agree' and 'mostly disagree'. The statement itself names no year; the table heading is 'Future III Scenarios for 2020'.

entries.label: Next-generation research will be used to improve the current Internet; it won't replace it
entries.quote: In 2020, the original Internet architecture is in the continuing process of refinement - it hasn't been replaced by a completely new system. [...] Search, security, and reliability on the Internet are easier and more refined, but those who want to commit crimes and mischief are still able to cause trouble.
entries.subject: internet architecture continuity
entries.note: Answer options were 'mostly agree' and 'mostly disagree'. The all-respondents line prints 19% disagree and '*' no response, which does not fit the experts' 6% disagree and 16% no response; possible print error in the source.

entries.label: Few lines divide professional time from personal time, and that's OK
entries.quote: In 2020, well-connected knowledge workers in more-developed nations have willingly eliminated the industrial-age boundaries between work hours and personal time. Outside of formally scheduled activities, work and play are seamlessly integrated in most of these workers' lives. This is a net-positive for people.
entries.subject: telework and work-life boundaries
entries.note: Answer options were 'mostly agree' and 'mostly disagree'.

notes: Eight 'mostly agree' / 'mostly disagree' scenarios for 2020. share_agree and share_disagree are for the 578 invited experts; share_all_respondents adds 618 other participants (1,196 total), as the report prints both. No other quantified question found. Open-ended elaborations are not captured. Non-random sample.
